_comment: QA suites the desk can start with one button. Step types: command (a name from desk.json commands), automation (needs desk.json filter_command), shot (needs desk.json shots), sheets (manual, from the sheets file), playtest (manual, the open phase's gate). Automated steps run in order; manual ones wait in the suite run for a person.

suites.name: Smoke
suites.description: Is the tracker sane? Add the project's fast tests here as commands.

suites.name: The phase gate
suites.description: Everything automated, the manual sheets, then a stranger. The phase is signed on this run and nothing else.
